skill.name: pytest-recording
skill.description: Work with pytest-recording (VCR.py) for recording and replaying HTTP interactions in tests. Use when writing VCR tests, managing cassettes, configuring VCR options, filtering sensitive data, or debugging recorded HTTP responses.
skill.summary: Guide pytest-recording setup, cassette management, secret filtering, and VCR.py debugging for HTTP tests.
skill.author: bossjones

security_audit.summary: I found no malicious intent or prompt injection in SKILL.md. The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline flags, VCR configuration examples, localhost ignore settings, and redaction key names. The skill is documentation for pytest-recording and includes guidance to filter secrets before committing cassettes.

static_findings.snippet: | `none` | `--vcr-record=none` | Only replay, fail if no cassette |
Cassettes are stored in `tests/cassettes/` by default, organized by test module:
1. Run with `--vcr-record=once` to create missing cassettes
2. Or use `--vcr-record=rewrite` to refresh all cassettes
3. Add any query param auth to `filter_query_parameters`
3. Verify cassette file exists and is valid YAML

content.value_statement: HTTP tests often fail when external APIs change or rate limit requests. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code configure pytest-recording cassettes.
actual_capabilities: Shows pytest-recording commands for replaying, creating, and refreshing cassettes.
Demonstrates pytest.mark.vcr usage for default, named, and multiple cassette tests.
Explains vcr_config settings for matching, record modes, ignored hosts, and serializers.
Lists header and query parameter filters for common LLM provider credentials.
Provides troubleshooting steps for missing, stale, or mismatched cassettes.
Describes the default cassette directory layout used by pytest-recording.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not run tests without user approval.
It covers pytest-recording and VCR.py, not every HTTP mocking library.
It cannot guarantee cassettes are free of secrets without manual review.
Live recording depends on local credentials, network access, and API stability.

use_cases.title: Stabilize API Test Suites
use_cases.description: Add VCR cassettes so HTTP tests replay known responses during normal test runs.

use_cases.title: Protect Recorded Credentials
use_cases.description: Configure header and query filters before recording requests against paid or private APIs.

use_cases.title: Maintain LLM Provider Tests
use_cases.description: Refresh stale cassettes and add provider-specific authentication filters for model API tests.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic VCR Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add pytest-recording to one API test. Use a simple pytest.mark.vcr example and explain the cassette name.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Safe Filters
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my pytest-recording configuration and suggest filter_headers, filter_query_parameters, and ignore_hosts for API tests.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Cassette Matching
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze why this pytest-recording cassette does not match my current request. Compare method, host, path, and query settings.

prompt_templates.title: Design Provider Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pytest-recording strategy for multiple LLM providers with record modes, cassette review steps, and secret filtering rules.

output_examples.input: A developer asks why VCR cannot find a cassette for one test.
output: Check that the cassette path matches the test module.
Run the test once with recording enabled.
Review the cassette name and fixture scope.

output_examples.input: A team adds a new LLM provider to recorded tests.
output: Add header and query parameter filters.

output_examples.input: Existing cassettes contain stale response data.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends refreshing affected cassettes first, then using rewrite mode when broader API changes require it.

best_practices: Filter authentication headers and query parameters before recording cassettes.
Review cassette changes in pull requests before committing them.
Use the narrowest recording mode that solves the current test problem.
anti_patterns: Do not commit cassettes before checking for tokens, keys, or cookies.
Do not use live recording for routine test runs.
Do not refresh all cassettes when one cassette is stale.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps create reliable pytest HTTP tests by recording and replaying VCR.py cassettes.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it help avoid leaking API keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows filters for common authentication headers and query parameters.

faq.question: Can it debug cassette mismatches?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests checking request matching criteria and comparing cassette details.

faq.question: Does it make live network requests by itself?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and configurations that users may choose to run.

faq.question: When should cassettes be regenerated?
faq.answer: Regenerate them when API responses intentionally change or a cassette is missing.
